# ResQ Viz

> Real-time 3D coordination for autonomous drone swarms — mesh topology, hazard
> fusion, and decentralized consensus when infrastructure fails.

ResQ Viz is the browser-based visualization surface for ResQ Tactical OS, the
decentralized kinetic operating system for autonomous disaster response. It
renders a live simulation of a drone swarm — flight dynamics, mesh link
topology, hazard fields, and terrain — streamed from an ASP.NET Core simulation
host over SignalR.

Site root: https://viz.resq.software/

## Shape of this site

This is a single-route WebGL2 application, not a document site. There are no
sub-pages to crawl: scenario, camera, and overlay state live in query
parameters on `/`. Rendering requires WebGL2 and JavaScript.

- [ResQ Viz](https://viz.resq.software/): the live 3D viewer.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [Sitemap XML](https://viz.resq.software/sitemap.xml)
- [Web app manifest](https://viz.resq.software/site.webmanifest)
- [Security contact (RFC 9116)](https://viz.resq.software/.well-known/security.txt)
- [Crawler policy](https://viz.resq.software/robots.txt): includes AIPREF
  `Content-Signal:` directives. ResQ opts out of AI *training* on this content
  while allowing real-time, user-prompted retrieval.

The REST API under `/api/` and the SignalR hub at `/viz` drive the simulation
and are not part of the public documented surface — they are disallowed in
`robots.txt` and are not a stable contract.
